headline: Argentine industrial union proposes 30-year fiscal stability regime
summary: During the Industrial Conference, the Argentine Industrial Union proposed a new regulatory framework featuring a 25% corporate tax rate and phased tax eliminations to boost sector competitiveness.
why: Tax policy proposals and structural reforms in major Latin American economies directly affect corporate profitability, industrial competitiveness, and investor sentiment.

impacts.name: Argentine Industrial Sector
impacts.why: Proposed tax cuts and long-term fiscal stability could improve sector margins if adopted.
